breakdown.description: Each CCD direction is paired with the opposite direction's `PROCAR` file instead of its own matching file.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error. It explicitly pairs `v_Ga/ccd_0_-1` vaspruns with `v_Ga/ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR` and `v_Ga/ccd_-1_0` vaspruns with `v_Ga/ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR` (cross-pairing). The ground truth requires each CCD direction to be paired with its own matching PROCAR file: `v_Ga/ccd_0_-1` with `v_Ga/ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR` and `v_Ga/ccd_-1_0` with `v_Ga/ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR`. The inconsistency was not fixed.
